# tests/test_borrow.py
from src.loan.store import save_loan, count_active, reset
from src.loan.borrow import LIMIT

def test_sixth_rejected():
    reset()
    for i in range(6):
        save_loan('r1', f'b{i}')
    assert count_active('r1') > LIMIT
